text:
maya: Heads up — Grafana alert fired for eu-west1-gpu logs showing a sudden gap in tenant_id labels ~ 11:05 UTC. Affected queries return lots of `tenant=""` or no tenant label at all.

jordan: saw that too. alert: `loki_count_missing_tenant_labels > 100/min for 5m` from alertmanager.

infra-bot: [ALERT] loki_missing_label_count(eu-west1) = 214 @ 11:06:23 UTC :pagerduty: 

ravi: quick check — are these logs missing the header or is the label being dropped by Loki ingestion? Can someone paste a raw log line from a node?

maya: pasted one from fluentd before forwarding: ```2026-03-18T10:59:41Z host=gpu-node-23 svc=gpu-worker msg=\"start session\" tenant_id=\"\" trace_id=abcd1234```. We normally expect tenant_id=\"team-xyz\".

sam: I pulled the same time slice from the node's journalctl and the application is emitting tenant in the message. Fluentd seems to forward it but the label is gone after the egress hop.

fluentd-bot: Notice: fluentd forwarding retried 12x due to connection reset at 10:59:52 from ip=34.102.45.98 (nat-gw-3). Buffer size ok.

jordan: That IP belongs to the VPC NAT pool for eu-west1. We had a NAT rotation earlier for capacity reasons ~10:58. Could the egress connection be re-established without the original TCP session that included the TLS SNI or proxy headers? Maybe an L7 sidecar adds tenant label then reconnect loses it.

ravi: hypothesis: sidecar (log-enricher) sets `tenant` label by looking up connection metadata on established connection. When NAT gateway rotates IP mid-stream, enricher loses context and forwards raw message to fluentd without enrichment.

maya: reproducer idea — trigger a NAT rebind on a test node and tail logs through sidecar -> fluentd -> loki. Also check `iptables` MASQUERADE sessions.

sam: I ran a quick loki ingestion audit: `label_max_length` not hit, but there are many entries with `__missing_tenant=1` added by loki relabel config. Example query I used: ```{job=\"fluentd\",region=\"eu-west1\"} |= \"tenant_id=\\\"\\\"\" | count_over_time({job=\"fluentd\",region=\"eu-west1\"}[15m])``` returned 220.

ops-oncall: Prometheus alert is noisy. We should silence for the eu-west1 window while we triage and tune the alert to use rate() and a higher threshold. Created quiet window on the alert group for 30m.

jordan: I'd like to see the nat-gw flow logs for the time window. Ravi, can you ask infra-team to fetch VPC flow logs for nat-gw-3 for 10:50-11:10?

ravi: already requested. Flow logs show multiple short-lived UDP/TCP sessions from worker nodes during the rotation. Attaching snippet: ```src=10.128.4.12 dst=34.102.45.98 start=11:58:52 end=11:58:52 flags=RST```.

maya: action item: (1) push short-term patch to log-enricher to fallback to parsing tenant_id from message body if connection metadata missing; (2) increase loki relabeling grace to not convert missing->empty for 1h; (3) add a Grafana panel showing % of logs missing tenant label by pool.

sam: On (1) — quick patch ready in branch `fix/enricher-tenant-fallback`, can cut a canary to eu-west1-nodepool-beta. It adds: ```if !metadata.tenant { tenant = parse_from_payload(payload) }```.

ravi: On (2) — loki relabel config currently drops label when empty: `tenant=\"\" -> drop`. Changing to add `__missing_tenant=1` for 10m is safer. I'll open a change and coordinate with eng-runtime to deploy.

ops-oncall: Also recommend we tweak the prometheus alert to use `sum(rate(loki_ingest_relabel_missing_tenant[5m])) by (region) > 50` to avoid single-node spikes.

jordan: We should also add a debug dashboard that correlates NAT gateway rotations (GCP API event), flow log resets, and Loki ingestion spikes. That will help confirm the root cause.

maya: I ran a Kibana discovery query on archived logs: ```tenant_id: * NOT tenant_id: \"team-*\" AND source:gpu-worker```, it highlighted affected nodes. Creating a short list of pods to repro.

fluentd-bot: Deploy note: `fix/enricher-tenant-fallback` canary scheduled to eu-west1-beta at 11:40 UTC. CI tests passed.

ravi: ops change submitted for loki relabel with rollback plan. If we still see missing tenants after patch, escalate to networking to avoid NAT rotation during heavy log periods.

maya: thanks — I'll monitor the canary and update this thread. If canary looks good, plan to roll to prod tonight at 02:00 UTC with a 30m observation window.

ops-oncall: created ticket INFRA-3241 with assignees: maya, ravi, jordan. ETA for full rollout: 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC.

maya: update — canary showed 0 missing tenant labels in the 15m after deployment. Looks promising. Closing the immediate incident, moving to follow-up action items in INFRA-3241. :thumbsup:
